data.fund_name: Union Gold ETF Fund of Fund
data.fund_type: An open-ended Fund of Fund Scheme investing in units of Union Gold ETF
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to generate long-term capital appreciation by investing in units of Union Gold ETF. However, there is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Units of Union Gold ETF-95%-100% of Net Asset, Debt and Money Market Instruments including units of debt oriented mutual fund schemes-0%-5% of Net Asset. Please refer the Scheme Information Document for more details.
data.exit_load: 1% if redeemed or switched out on or before completion of 1 year from the date of allotment of units. Nil if redeemed or switched out after completion of 1 year from the date of allotment of units.
